tools.name: validate_json
tools.description: Validate a JSON instance against an optional JSON Schema and return RFC 8785 canonical JSON plus SHA-256. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/validate.

instance.description: JSON value to validate. Any JSON type is accepted.

schema.description: JSON Schema to validate instance against. Optional. If omitted, the instance is accepted and only canonicalized.

canonicalize.description: If true (default), return RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON, its SHA-256 hex digest, and byte length.

tools.name: csv_to_json
tools.description: Convert CSV to JSON rows with per-column type inference (integer, number, boolean, null, string), delimiter auto-detection and a generated JSON Schema. Leading-zero codes (ZIP, CLABE) stay strings. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/csv-to-json.

csv.description: CSV text (UTF-8). Max 1 MiB, 20,000 rows, 512 columns.

csv_base64.description: Alternative to 'csv': base64 bytes (UTF-8 or Latin-1).

null_values.description: Strings treated as null (empty is always null).

tools.name: json_diff
tools.description: Compare two JSON documents and return the RFC 6902 JSON Patch that turns source into target, plus canonical SHA-256 of each side. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/json-diff.

tools.name: json_patch
tools.description: Apply an RFC 6902 JSON Patch to a JSON document and return the result and its canonical SHA-256. Failed 'test' ops return 409 and are not charged. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/json-patch.

patch.description: RFC 6902 operations (add, remove, replace, move, copy, test). Max 10,000.

tools.name: pdf_text
tools.description: Extract text per page from a PDF given by public URL or base64 (max 4 MiB, 100 pages). No OCR: scanned PDFs are flagged as likely_scanned. Price: 0.02 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/pdf-text.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the PDF (max 4 MiB, 3 redirects, public IPs only).

pdf_base64.description: Alternative to 'url': base64 PDF bytes (max 4 MiB decoded).

pages.description: 1-based pages to read. Default: all (up to max_pages).

joined.description: Also return all pages joined in 'text'.

tools.name: pdf_tables
tools.description: Extract tables (rows and header-keyed records) from a PDF given by public URL or base64 (max 4 MiB, 30 pages). 'lines' strategy for ruled tables, 'text' for whitespace-aligned ones. Price: 0.04 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/pdf-tables.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the PDF (max 4 MiB, 3 redirects, public IPs only).

pdf_base64.description: Alternative to 'url': base64 PDF bytes (max 4 MiB decoded).

pages.description: 1-based pages to read. Default: all (up to max_pages).

strategy.description: 'lines' for ruled tables, 'text' for whitespace-aligned columns.

header.description: Also return rows as records keyed by the first row.

tools.name: mx_rfc
tools.description: Validate a Mexican RFC tax ID (persona física or moral): format, embedded date, homoclave and SAT check digit. Offline; does not query SAT. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/mx/rfc.

value.description: RFC (12 or 13 chars). Spaces, dashes and lowercase are normalized.

tools.name: mx_curp
tools.description: Validate a Mexican CURP: format, birth date, sex, state code, internal consonants and RENAPO check digit. Offline; does not query RENAPO. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/mx/curp.

value.description: CURP (18 chars). Spaces, dashes and lowercase are normalized.

tools.name: mx_clabe
tools.description: Validate an 18-digit Mexican CLABE bank account: SPEI bank code (with bank name), plaza, account and check digit. Offline; does not confirm the account exists. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/mx/clabe.

value.description: CLABE (18 digits). Spaces, dashes and lowercase are normalized.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free. Lists every paid tool with its price, HTTP endpoint and an example input, and explains how to pay with x402.
